BuyWise 1.5.5

- Added a user feedback prompt section to SKILL.md, clarifying when and how to show a star request at the end of the first helpful reply.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md documentation file.
- General documentation updates and refinements in README.md and SKILL.md to reflect new feedback instructions and improve clarity.

- Updated English documentation in SKILL.md for clarity and completeness
- Expanded and improved keywords in package.json for broader discoverability
- Kept functionality unchanged; these are documentation and metadata improvements only

- Removed dependency on the gstack skill; BuyWise now navigates data pages directly with its built-in browser tool.
- Updated documentation to reflect the new browser-based workflow and eliminated mentions of external skill requirements.
- No changes to the user-facing functionality or platform coverage.

- Routine version update with no user-facing changes.
- Internal update: package.json modified; no changes to features, functionality, or documentation.

- Added a README.md file for improved documentation and onboarding.

v1.2.0: Add Google Shopping (google.com/search?tbm=shop) as primary international price aggregator — covers Amazon/eBay/Walmart/Best Buy and dozens more in one page; Bing Shopping as fallback; JD direct check added to China flow

v1.1.0: Replace web_search price guessing with browser-direct navigation to smzdm.com (China aggregator), CamelCamelCamel (Amazon history), amazon.com, ebay.com, aliexpress.com — real prices only, no fabrication
Initial release: cross-platform price comparison (Amazon/eBay/AliExpress/Temu/JD/Taobao/Tmall), fake deal detection, review summarization, alternative recommendations, buy timing advice
